description:
InfoMosaic-Bench Dataset
	


	
		
		Overview
	

The InfoMosaic-Bench dataset (from arXiv:2510.02271) is designed to evaluate multi-source information seeking and reasoning capabilities of tool-augmented language models. It includes diverse tasks across multiple domains such as finance, biomedicine, geography, web, and video. Each task requires combining evidence from different sources to satisfy multiple logical or numerical constraints.
The benchmark provides a systematic evaluation… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Dorothydu/InfoMosaic_Bench.
evaluation_method: composite task score combining factual accuracy, constraint satisfaction, and numerical correctness (task_success_rate / composite_score)
reputation: New and emerging dataset aimed at evaluating tool-augmented models on multi-source evidence synthesis; gaining attention but not yet widely benchmarked.
